releaseNotes:
• WhatsApp Status Saver 100% Detection Fix: Full multi-path scan + Android 11-15 Storage Access Framework (SAF) folder picker integration for guaranteed status detection & saving
• Removed 'Open WhatsApp' from Status Saver page with dedicated 'Grant Status Folder Access' & 'Refresh'
• Stream-Based Gallery Saver: High-speed saving to Pictures/PS_Board_Statuses with instant MediaStore indexing
• Video Status Preview & Direct Media Player playback
• Refined Glassmorphism UI: Emerald neon accents, status counters, rounded 16dp luxury cards
